6. Write the reason behind the atmosphere does not escape away from the Earth.
Ans:- The atmosphere does not escape away from the Earth Because of the gravitational force of attraction exerted by the
Sun, which keeps them in their orbits.
7. Why do all planets and satellites revolve round the sun?
Ans:- All planets and satellites revolve round the sun because of the gravitational force of attraction exerted by the Sun,
which keeps them in their orbits.
8. We do not get hurt, when we jump with parachute. Why?
Ans:- We do not get hurt, when we jump with parachute because the parachute increases air resistance, reducing the falling
speed and making the landing gentle.

10. Acceleration due to gravity is not the same in all parts of the earth. Why?
Ans:- Acceleration due to gravity is not the same in all parts of the earth because g = GM/R² and two effects change it: (1)
Earth is not a perfect sphere (it's flattened at the poles), so surface distance RRR from Earth’s center varies with latitude; (2)
Earth’s rotation produces a centrifugal effect that reduces effective gravity more at the equator than at the poles. Both make g
vary with place.
11. Jumping from a significant height may cause more injury. Why?
Ans:- A larger fall more gravitational potential energy converted to kinetic energy larger impact speed and larger
impulse/force on landing. The bigger the speed at impact, the greater the force and therefore the greater the injury risk.
12. Mass of Jupiter is about 319 times the mass of the Earth, but its acceleration due to gravity is only about 2.5 times the
acceleration due to gravity of the Earth. Why?

Ans:- Mass of Jupiter is about 319 times the mass of the Earth, but its acceleration due to gravity is only about 2.5 times the acceleration due to gravity of the Earth because g=GM/R2 . Jupiter’s mass is much larger, but its radius is also much larger (≈11× Earth’s radius). The huge increase in R2 offsets part of the mass increase, so net g grows only ~2.5×.
13. Among the objects dropped from the same height in the polar region and the equatorial region of the earth, the object
dropped in the polar region falls faster. Why?
Ans:- Two reasons: (a) poles are closer to Earth’s center (larger g), and (b) centrifugal effect from Earth’s rotation is zero at
the poles but maximal at the equator (it reduces effective gravity at equator). So effective g is larger at poles faster fall.
14. Out of two paper sheets, one is folded to form a ball. If the paper ball and the sheet of paper are dropped simultaneously
in the air, the folded paper will fall faster. Why?
Ans:- The folded paper ball has much smaller surface area and thus less air resistance; hence it experiences a larger net
downward acceleration and reaches the ground sooner.
15. When a marble and a feather are dropped simultaneously in a vacuum, they reach the ground together (at the same time).
Why?
Ans:- In vacuum there is no air resistance, so both experience the same gravitational acceleration g; identical acceleration so
they fall together.
16. As you climb Mount Everest, the weight of the goods that you carry decreases. Why?
Ans:- Weight W =mg. As you climb, your distance from Earth’s center increases, so local g decreases; with smaller g, weight
decreases (mass unchanged).
17. It is difficult to lift a big stone on the surface of the earth, but it is easy to lift a smaller one. Why?
Ans:- It is difficult to lift a big stone on the surface of the earth, but it is easy to lift a smaller one Because a bigger stone has
larger mass → larger weight W =mg. Greater weight requires a larger upward force to lift it.
18. One will have an eerie feeling when he/she moves down while playing a Rote Ping. Why?
Ans:- A rote-ping is a rotating swing (merry-go-round style). When you move down or change velocity there are abrupt
changes in acceleration (centripetal/centrifugal effects) and in the normal force on your body. Those rapid changes in
apparent weight and the vestibular organs in your inner ear produce the “eerie” or dizzy sensation.
